observation.command:
timeout 300 docker run --rm postgres:17-bookworm bash -c '
apt-get update >/dev/null 2>&1
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends postgresql-17-postgis-3 postgresql-17-pgrouting >/dev/null 2>&1
dpkg -l | grep -E "postgresql-17-postgis-3 |postgresql-17-pgrouting " | awk "{print \$2, \$3}"
' 2>&1 | tail
